title: PDF preview
noConditions: This template has no conditions: the result is always the same.
exampleBroken: This sample data cannot be read: {{reason}}. Pick another one.
variantNoPdf: This variant does not produce a PDF.

stale.conditions: The conditions changed after the build. Build again so the page matches them.
stale.files: Files changed after the build. Build again to see your edits.

noPdf.title: This document is not built as a PDF
noPdf.lead: The preview shows only documents that become a PDF. Presentations and similar files are not included.

notInKit.title: This document is not in the set under these conditions
notInKit.lead: The student will not get it, so there is no page.

quota: The maximum number of builds is running ({{limit}}). Wait for one to finish and build again.

error.render_failed: The template could not be filled with data: the text has an error or the build took too long.
error.interrupted: The build was interrupted by a Studio restart. Build again.
error.pdf_missing: The build finished but no PDF appeared.
error.build_failed: The document did not build: the text has an error.
error.font_missing: The build server does not have a font the document needs.

errorHint: The place of the error is shown in the build log.

noDocument.title: Pick a document
noDocument.lead: Pick a document on the left: its PDF preview will appear here.
noDocument.leadEmpty: This version has no documents yet. Add the first one and its preview will appear here.
